title: data/issues.json
description: Hand-written and auto-detected issues. Entries with source=auto are regenerated on every ingest; source=manual entries are never touched by machinery.

id.description: Stable slug. For auto issues it is derived from rule + subject so re-ingest updates rather than duplicates.

project.description: Must match a project id in content/projects/

server.description: Must be a key in data/servers.json

rule.description: Required when source=auto. The §9 rule that fired, e.g. db-port-exposed, ufw-inactive, unit-failed, cert-expiring, kernel-stale, disk-high, container-stuck-created, cron-secret, sites-enabled-not-symlink.

evidence.description: The observed fact that fired the rule. Redacted like everything else in data/.

claim.description: A statement about live state that this hand-written issue rests on. Every build re-tests it against the newest ingest, so a doc claim that has since been fixed is shown as reconciled instead of being repeated as current fact. This is what stops the docs and the dashboard drifting apart.

path.description: Dotted path into the server record, for kind=value
